Donald is an ancestor of Denise (Donald → Michael → Scott → Brian → Christine → Sandra → Denise), and Denise is an ancestor of Doris (Denise → … → Andrew → Doris).  
So Donald is an ancestor of Doris.

Independently, Charles is also an ancestor of Doris (Charles → Jesse → … → Joseph → Jacob → Gerald → Doris).

Therefore, Charles and Donald share a common descendant (Doris).

<ANSWER>4</ANSWER>
